Terms of Use

What this app is. The Daily Question reads Chinese calendrical charts - four pillars, and three classical divination methods - and writes out what the tradition says about them. It is a cultural and reflective tool.

What it is not

Nothing here is medical, legal, financial or psychological advice. The app states tendencies, never verdicts, and publishes the arithmetic behind each one so you can see how it got there. Where we have measured how often a method agrees with itself by chance, we print that number next to the reading. Decisions about your health, your money or your legal position belong with a qualified professional.

Subscription

The full reading is offered as an auto-renewable subscription, monthly or yearly. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel it in your device Settings under your Apple ID, Subscriptions. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription.

If you previously bought the full reading as a one-time purchase, it stays yours. You do not need a subscription, and you will not be charged again.

Your content

What you type stays on your own device. The app contains no network code and cannot send it anywhere. We never receive it and cannot recover it for you - if you delete the app, it is gone.

Ownership

The text, artwork, and the way these methods are computed here are ours. Please do not copy them out for commercial use.

Changes

If these terms change, the new version ships inside an app update, and continuing to use the app means you accept it.

Contact

Root Chakra Holy Inc. Written by the developer, not a support desk - replies take a few days.

这个应用是什么。《每日一问》读的是中国传统历法命盘 —— 四柱，以及三套古典术数方法 —— 并把传统对它们的说法写出来。它是一件文化性、反思性的工具。

它不是什么

这里没有任何医疗、法律、财务或心理方面的建议。本应用只陈述倾向，从不下判决， 并且把每一条背后的算式都印出来，好让你看见它是怎么得出的。凡是我们量过「某个方法与自身 偶然相符的频率」的地方，我们都会把那个数字印在解读旁边。关于你的健康、你的钱、 你的法律处境的决定，应当交给有资质的专业人士。

Privacy Policy

Short version: this app collects nothing. It contains no network code of any kind and cannot transmit anything anywhere. Every calculation runs on your device.

What you enter

The app asks for a date of birth, a time of birth and a sex. These are the mathematical inputs to a four-pillar chart and are used for nothing else. They are held in your device's local storage, on your device only. We never receive them and cannot see them.

What you write

Anything you type into the app stays in the same local storage on your own device. It is never uploaded, published, shared, or made visible to anyone.

What we collect

Nothing. There is no account, no sign-up, no sign-in, no analytics, no advertising, no crash reporting and no third-party SDKs. The app requests no device permissions: no location, contacts, camera, microphone, photos, notifications, or tracking.

Deleting your data

Because your data never leaves your device, deleting the app deletes all of it. There is nothing held elsewhere for us to delete, and no request you need to send us.

Children

This app is intended for adults. It collects no information from anyone, including children.

Changes and contact

If this policy changes, the updated version ships inside the app. Questions:
